words.meaning: A symbol of abundance and nourishment, typically depicted as a goat's horn overflowing with fruit, flowers, and corn; a rich and joyful harvest abundance.
words.sentence1: The autumn banquet table was adorned with a cornucopia filled with ripe pomegranates, grapes, and golden squash. (The autumn banquet table was adorned with a cornucopia filled with ripe pomegranates, grapes, and golden squash.)
words.sentence2: After months of dedicated farming, the fertile valley yielded a veritable cornucopia of produce for the entire township. (After months of dedicated farming, the fertile valley yielded a veritable cornucopia of produce for the entire township.)

words.meaning: The gathering or reaping of crops; the harvested produce, celebrated with communal joy.
words.sentence1: La comunidad celebro la abundante cosecha con musica y danzas tradicionales. (The community celebrated the abundant harvest with traditional music and dances.)
words.sentence2: Este otono promete una cosecha excepcional de trigo y maiz para todos los agricultores. (This autumn promises an exceptional harvest of wheat and corn for all the farmers.)

words.meaning: The gathering of agricultural yields or crops; the fruit of agrarian toil that brings seasonal celebration.
words.sentence1: Apres des mois de dur labeur, la recolte des pommes a enfin commence dans la vallee. (After months of hard work, the apple harvest has finally begun in the valley.)
words.sentence2: Les villageois partagent un repas chaleureux pour saluer une bonne recolte de ble. (The villagers share a warm meal to welcome a good wheat harvest.)

words.meaning: The harvest; the gathering of agricultural crops representing nature's bounty and joyful fulfillment.
words.sentence1: Die Bauern freuten sich ueber die reiche Ernte in diesem wunderschoenen Herbst. (The farmers rejoiced over the rich harvest in this wonderful autumn.)
words.sentence2: Waehrend der Ernte herrscht auf den goldenen Feldern ein geschaeftiges und froehliches Treiben. (During the harvest, bustling and cheerful activity prevails across the golden fields.)

words.meaning: Harvesting or collecting crops; the yield reaped with satisfaction and celebration.
words.sentence1: Mura no hitobito wa aki no shuukaku o iwatte nigiyaka na matsuri o hirakimashita. (The villagers held a lively festival to celebrate the autumn harvest.)
words.sentence2: Kotoshi wa tensou ni megumare, kome no shuukaku ga totemo yutaka deshita. (Blessed with good weather this year, the rice harvest was very plentiful.)

words.meaning: The seasonal harvest, reaping of agricultural produce, and the collective bounty of the soil.
words.sentence1: I contadini cantavano con allegria durante il ricco raccolto di olive tra le colline toscane. (The farmers sang joyfully during the rich olive harvest among the Tuscan hills.)
words.sentence2: Un abbondante raccolto autunnale porta sempre serenita e prosperita a tutto il borgo. (An abundant autumn harvest always brings serenity and prosperity to the whole village.)

words.meaning: The autumn harvest; the seasonal reaping of crops symbolizing plentiful food and celebration.
words.sentence1: Jin tian shi qiushou de rizi, nongmin men de lian shang yangyi zhe xinyue de xiao rong. (Today is the day of autumn harvest, and the farmers' faces are radiant with happy smiles.)
words.sentence2: Jiaxiang de tiandi li, qiushou de huange zai jinse de suiyue zhong changxiang. (In the fields of the hometown, joyous harvest songs resound through the golden days.)

words.meaning: The autumn harvest; the gathering of grain and crops accompanied by joyful thanksgiving festivities.
words.sentence1: Maeul jumin-deul-eun chusu-reul machigo modu moyeo ddeok-gwa eumsik-eul nanumnida. (After finishing the harvest, the village residents all gather together to share rice cakes and food.)
words.sentence2: Gaeul deulpan-eun hwanggeumbit chusu-ui bbeudeutham-euro gadeuk chamnida. (The autumn fields are filled with the rewarding pride of the golden harvest.)

words.meaning: Reaping or harvesting agricultural crops, an occasion of collective community cooperation and cheer.
words.sentence1: Neak srok prachum knea daembey chrot-kat srov doy chet sabay rik-reay. (The villagers assemble together to harvest rice with joyous hearts.)
words.sentence2: Pel chrot-kat ban banhchob, krup knea chong-cham nov pheap sross-sroul ney phol-damnam. (When harvesting is concluded, everyone commemorates the delightful abundance of the crops.)

words.meaning: The harvest or crop yield; the gathering of nature's fruit bringing contentment and relief.
words.sentence1: Die boere vier die goeie oes met 'n gesellige braai en vrolike musiek op die plaas. (The farmers celebrate the good harvest with a cozy barbecue and cheerful music on the farm.)
words.sentence2: Vanjaar se goue oes van koring bring groot verligting en dankbaarheid vir die hele streek. (This year's golden harvest of wheat brings great relief and gratitude to the entire region.)
